text: Financial management is one of the core areas of enterprise management, focusing on the raising, utilization, allocation and risk control of organizational funds, and supporting the realization of enterprise strategic goals through financial decisions. This major is based on accounting and economics, integrating knowledge from finance, law, data analysis, etc., to cultivate management-oriented talents with the abilities of financial analysis, investment decision-making, financing planning, and cost control. Students need to master the full-process logic from financial statement interpretation to enterprise value assessment, and learn to apply financial models (such as DCF cash flow discounting) and digital tools (such as ERP systems, financial analysis software) to solve practical problems. This program is suitable for students who are sensitive to numbers, good at logical analysis, and wish to participate in enterprise strategic decision-making.
